prompt: Read STATUS.md and tell me in three bullets where the project stands and what the next action is.
Read scripts/recommend.py and explain how it avoids picking 25 near-identical images.
Open scripts/generate.py and list its command-line options with one line each.
Which scripts under scripts/ reference the wildcards directory? List file and line number.
Find every place in this directory that mentions seed 88109 and tell me what it refers to.
Search the Python scripts for the code that parses the --keep argument and show me how the comma-separated list is handled.
How many lines are in each wildcards/*.txt file, and which pool is the largest?
List the API-format workflow JSON files under workflows/ with their sizes in bytes, largest first.
Count the lines in casting.log and tell me how many casting entries took longer than 40 seconds.
In dataset_manifest.json, count how many entries there are per style and per lighting value. Give two small tables.
casting_seeds_natural.json and casting_seeds_goth.json: how many seeds are in each, and do any seed values overlap?
Look at dataset_analysis.json: what fields does each entry have, and what are the min, max and mean of whichever field looks like an identity score?
Parse wildcards/outfit.txt and wildcards/setting.txt and write out/combos.csv with the first 20 outfit,setting pairs (header row included).
Write out/pipeline.md: a one-page summary of the pipeline stages described in README.md and STATUS.md, naming the script that implements each stage.
Create out/wildcards_stats.json with, for each wildcard file, the number of lines and the longest line.
Write a small Python script out/pick_seeds.py that reads casting_seeds_natural.json and prints the seed for each candidate number given on the command line.
In scripts/generate.py the --count option accepts any integer. Patch it so values below 1 raise an argparse error.
Add a --dry-run flag to scripts/generate.py that prints the expanded prompts and exits without contacting the server. Keep the change minimal.
Check wildcards/pose.txt for blank lines or trailing whitespace and, if there are any, clean the file in place.
Work out which workflow file scripts/cast.py uses by default, open that workflow and tell me which checkpoint model it loads.
Compare install_deps.sh and install_nodes.sh: list which pip packages and which custom nodes they install, then write out/deps.md with both lists.
Read run_comfy.ps1 and download_models.sh and list every absolute path they assume exists; save the list to out/paths.txt.
What is a LoRA, and why might 25 curated images be enough to train one for a single face?
Explain in two sentences what the wildcards mechanism in this project does.
